messages.plaintextBody:
All,

We're targeting signing on 9 April and completion on 17 April. Subscription monies (£55m) to WC client account by 16 April. Signing pages to be collected in counterpart via DocuSign. Board and shareholder resolutions circulated separately. Please flag any issues with the timetable.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
